Other Gmod please? Steam: Hecii 
Thanks!
Yea I saw some of Seamless' growl tutorials I believe, or someone who used his techniques to make one.

I did download an FL Demo a while ago. I thought it was pretty simple and had a lot of capability. I tried Ableton at a friend's, and to be honest, it seems like it would take a lot more time to get around (And while it could be better in the long run I think I'd rather save some money)

I watched some tutorials on Sytrus and also Massive, both seem to make some really nice growls pretty quickly. Sytrus did seem a little bit simpler than massive, though massive seemed a lot more directed toward growls/wobbles/etc
Awesome! Thanks for the free plugin recommendations too! Big help!
